places.name: Khatyn Memorial
places.connection: The film's depiction of the massacre was inspired by the real-life events at Khatyn, and some scenes were filmed in the surrounding areas.

places.name: Minsk Region
places.connection: Various scenes were shot in the rural areas and forests around Minsk, capturing the natural landscape.

places.name: Nesvizh
places.connection: Some scenes were filmed in the vicinity of Nesvizh, utilizing its historical and cultural backdrop.

places.name: Belarusian State Film Studio (Belarusfilm)
places.connection: Interior scenes and post-production work were completed at this studio.

places.name: Volozhin
places.connection: Filming took place in the rural areas around Volozhin, capturing the essence of the Belarusian countryside.
